quotes.text: Only utilized the vertical free-free single bungee supported test configuration for modal correlation.
Only utilized impact hammer test data because the blocks used for shaker testing had a significant mass loading impact on the modes and didn’t want to include them in the FEM.
Correlation will struggle above 150 Hz and is unlikely to meet requirements above 200 Hz due to instrumentation placement.
Comparison stopped at 400 Hz due to sample rate of data acquisition system setting for the modal tests
the exact location of the impact in the frequency range above 150 Hz is critical
The modal test always averages ~10 impacts together
Every test mode that was included in the correlation was able to be extracted from two different test runs
The stainless-steel bottom box has been a very difficult part to correlate throughout this process and it is unknown why.
